19bc759a86c583bc.body:
Dear Releaf Support Team,

I am writing to raise a serious concern about my recent consultation and the ongoing pattern of errors affecting my care.

During my consultation on 3rd January 2026, I specifically discussed increasing my vape cartridge prescription so I could purchase the £199 850mg vape. The clinician AGREED with me and APPROVED this increase. This should be reflected in the consultation notes.

The proof that this conversation took place is that the vape product is now on my CHOSEN prescription list - not the outside list. This clearly demonstrates that the discussion happened and approval was given. Yet despite this, my vape cartridge allowance was not actually increased to allow me to order it.

This is now the FOURTH consultation where things have not gone to plan. I do not understand how the wires keep getting crossed between what is discussed and agreed in consultations versus what actually gets actioned on my account.

To make matters worse, because the Relief subscription was paid (in error - see separate email), my plan does not allow me to book another consultation to fix this. I am now being told I would have to pay £100 for another consultation just to correct YOUR error - an error where the clinician agreed and approved something that simply wasn't processed.

This is completely unacceptable. I should not have to pay £100 to fix a mistake that was not mine.

WHAT I NEED:
1. The vape cartridge prescription increase to be actioned immediately - as was agreed and approved in my January consultation
2. A review of why this keeps happening - this is the 4th consultation with issues
3. If a consultation is needed to fix this, it should be provided free of charge as this is your error, not mine
4. All outstanding refunds/credits from previous issues to be processed

The evidence is on my account - the product is on my chosen list, proving the discussion took place. Please action this urgently.

Kind regards,
Loz Turner
lozturner@gmail.com
